analyst_view.overall: Second-placed Lille (21 points), the league's best defence and unbeaten in five, host fifth-placed Lyon (17 points), who have lost three away league games in a row. Lyon start under new coach Carlos Vicens, a former Guardiola assistant who keeps the back four and wants a higher press; his first squad has Tagliafico (back late from Argentina duty), Kango and Himbert, but not Mata (muscle problem), Openda, Sulc, Morton or Ouédraogo, all but Mata counted by the numbers. For Lille, Davide Ancelotti confirmed Ayase Ueda is fit after a month out, though a start is uncertain with Giroud also an option; the numbers still count Ueda fully out, while Tiago Santos and Igamane are missing. Lille host Bayern in the Champions League next week, and François Letexier (4.0 cards a game) referees, already counted.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.1 goals and take about 9% off Lille's attack for Ueda, who is now fit and in the squad, even if probably from the bench. Giving some of that back, against a Lyon side short of forwards, I lean very slightly higher, to about 2.14.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.7 corners. Both sides play a 4-3-3 with wide forwards, and Vicens has kept Lyon's back four, so I see no reason to move from 9.7.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.4 cards, with Letexier's near-average record already in. Lyon's travelling fans are banned and nothing points to a heated game, so I stay at 4.4.

shots.text: The numbers say 21.9 shots. Lille's possession game and Vicens wanting a higher press could add a few, but Lyon are without Openda and Sulc up front and Mata at the back, so I stay at 21.9.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.3 shots on target. Ueda back in Lille's squad gives them a finisher the numbers count as missing, so I nudge it up to about 8.5.
